text.content:
Background figure (no actor sheet) · Camarilla Archon in the service of Justicar @UUID[JournalEntry.gSMgBLLYggWyAN2W]{Helena Panhard} · Role in @UUID[JournalEntry.ll97TEj4MRjtM595]{Chapter 7 · The Ward File}: waits on Bainbridge for the briefcase holding the File if @UUID[JournalEntry.uDNdrVnGBbAh18Tt]{Halloway} wins the Council (@UUID[JournalEntry.doItxeK8y7M1PufU.JournalEntryPage.tG1m5PTkmBA1pvmc]{A4-E03 · The Last Ferry}); lead figure of @UUID[JournalEntry.AnZpyM4onyACPwiC.JournalEntryPage.MbCyCqKpBUEan9GR]{GAN-07 · The Archon Calls}.

This page gathers what docs 00–16 say about Duval. The source doc for each fact is given in parentheses. The docs give him no first name, clan, or stats.

• He appears as a background figure, like Justicar Panhard and @UUID[JournalEntry.WIihWwv4LCOX68B1]{Vance} (doc 01, NPC index; ID registry v2: “PNJ-07 · Archon Duval (background)”).
  • He knew Vance (doc 09, @UUID[JournalEntry.AnZpyM4onyACPwiC.JournalEntryPage.MbCyCqKpBUEan9GR]{GAN-07 · The Archon Calls}).
  • He serves as Justicar Panhard's envoy (doc 13, @UUID[JournalEntry.doItxeK8y7M1PufU.JournalEntryPage.tG1m5PTkmBA1pvmc]{A4-E03 · The Last Ferry} and ID registry: “Archon Duval appears on Bainbridge as the Justicar's envoy”).

• Night 8. If Halloway wins the Council (@UUID[JournalEntry.doItxeK8y7M1PufU.JournalEntryPage.snrsN5RkdAklRIDn]{A4-E01 · Primogen Council}), at 12:30 a.m. Mr. Pell (@UUID[Actor.eRE6FTNdGO76lzPK]{Mr. Pell}) leaves Halloway Tower with the briefcase to hand over the original File “to an envoy of the Justicar on Bainbridge”: it is the proof Panhard asked of him before she will recognize the regency (doc 13, Storyteller Notes for A4-E01). Pell travels with Dawson and two ghouls (@UUID[Actor.BzNGxOAK3F6Uo56T]{Halloway's Security Ghouls}) and means “to deliver it to Archon Duval, who waits on Bainbridge as the Justicar's envoy, as proof of the ‘crisis’ that justifies the regency” (doc 13, A4-E03).
  • The endings. If the File reaches Duval and Halloway lost or was exposed: @UUID[JournalEntry.oyw1B5aZ7G2vFDuO.JournalEntryPage.UnOqmjERvnxNb7gL]{FIN-A · The Truth Before the Throne} (“Duval returns it”). If Halloway won: @UUID[JournalEntry.oyw1B5aZ7G2vFDuO.JournalEntryPage.RqeQkW5KfFjPYFhg]{FIN-B · The Hound Changes Masters}. If Halloway won but the coterie kept the File: partial FIN-B, because Halloway has no proof to show the Justicar (doc 13, endings table). The briefcase ending up “in Duval's hands” is one of the four possible endings (doc 13, Notes for A4-E03).

pages.name: Chronicle Hook: GAN-07 · The Archon Calls

text.content:
• Doc 01: “Duval asks a favor that forces David to leave the city.”
  • Doc 09: Mr. Pell typed three copies of Vance's journals. Halloway sent copy 3 to Justicar Panhard in 2025 as a goodwill gift. Duval, who knew Vance, has read it and wants to talk to @UUID[JournalEntry.3zcQLj7aEAxHT0Yr]{David}. He asks him to travel to Marseille. It isn't an order. Not yet.
    • Before answering, David tells the coterie. What they say carries weight, and if they go with him, the trip becomes a coterie story.
    • David goes: Duval shows him copy 3, which has folios that aren't in the other two, including the ones about Krell. David earns an Archon's favor (temporary Mawla 2), but he is away from Seattle for one story. If he goes alone, the coterie plays that story without him and without his +1 die. Proposed: the PC who went with him to Marseille shares Duval's favor (temporary Mawla 2).
    • David refuses: Duval doesn't press, but he takes note. Next time it will be an order.
    • Panhard takes an interest in Seattle: if the ending was FIN-B, the Justicar sends Duval to the city to investigate. He arrives with one question: who is Prince now?
